p1_b0.ocr: In the ever-evolving landscape of professional services, organizations must prioritize the continuous development of their workforce to maintain competitive advantage and meet the changing demands of the market.

p1_b1.ocr: Cognizant recognizes the critical role that training and certification play in equipping professionals with the necessary skills and knowledge. As such, the investment in training and certification costs has become a focal point in our strategic planning.

p1_b3.ocr: This report provides a comprehensive analysis of these costs over the three-year period from 2022 to 2024, reflecting our commitment to fostering a culture of lifelong learning and professional development. The accompanying table illustrates the projected training and certification costs for the years 2022, 2023, and 2024, alongside the calculated growth rates expressed in percentage terms. A detailed examination of these figures reveals not only the financial commitment to employee development but also highlights our proactive approach in adapting to industry trends and technological advancements. For instance, the data indicates a steady increase in the training and certification costs from 2022 to 2024, suggesting a strategic initiative to enhance the skill sets of our workforce in alignment with anticipated market demands. Moreover, the growth rate percentage serves as a key indicator of our investment trajectory, illustrating the organization's prioritization of training as a vital component in driving overall performance and innovation.

p1_b4.ocr: The upward trend in these costs can be attributed to several factors, including the increasing complexity of project requirements and the necessity for employees to acquire certifications in emerging technologies. This investment not only empowers our professionals but also ensures that Cognizant remains at the forefront of industry standards and practices. As we move forward into 2024, it is imperative that we continually assess the effectiveness of our training initiatives and their impact on employee performance and satisfaction. By maintaining a robust training framework, Cognizant aims to build a resilient workforce capable of navigating the challenges of the future. The data presented in the table provides a foundational understanding of our financial allocations towards training and certification, setting the stage for further discussions on optimizing these investments to achieve maximum return in both employee capability and organizational success.
